title: The Use of AI in 10-K Filings
subtitle: An Empirical Analysis on Russell 1000 Constituent Companies (2018-2024)
authors: Marcelo S. Perlin, Cristian R. Foguesatto, Aliki K. Galanos, Felipe Affonso
institute: Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS)
description: Empirical study evaluating the adoption of AI-assisted writing and sentiment analysis across 10-K annual reports of Russell 1000 companies from 2018 to 2024 using a custom FinBERT prediction model.
